paper.title: Towards Floquet Chern insulators of light
paper.original_label_error: Lower-right panel printed b), designated d) in caption; original retained.

task_scope: Actual Legume field-derived tensor coupling and polarization interference. No static disorder. No claim of modulation-only spatial disorder, full Floquet spectrum, radiative scattering efficiency or Chern invariant.

primary.model: one nondispersive static Maxwell model used consistently for all modes/operators

sensitivity.model: separate complete static model, no combining fields of different material models

materials.source: arXiv 2304.09385v1 Methods, local source_extracted/maintext.tex line236: n=3.47 at760nm, n=3.3 at1um, silica n1.46
materials.final_article_index_confirmation: Not confirmed: official main HTML and PDF URL both return subscription preview on 2026-10-19; neither exposes Methods or the index values. See final_methods_access.json.
materials.approximation: No published full-frequency constitutive curve has been verified. Primary fixed n is an explicit approximation for selection-rule comparison, not exact final-paper dispersion.

modulation.physical_mechanism: chi(2)-mediated non-diagonal permittivity under normal-incidence polarized pump
modulation.projection: unit tensor shape, no fitted pump magnitude
modulation.source: official SI Eqs.S2,S20a,S20b and Fig.S5 caption
modulation.pump_amplitude_note: Official SI Fig.S8 specifies chi_xyz=200pm/V and E=.353GV/m, but common amplitude for Fig.S5 is not verified. Not used to fit this comparison.
modulation.temporal_omega: not needed for this coupling-map observable

mode_identity.mode_1: TM-like yellow band near the paper short-wavelength resonance
mode_identity.mode_2: higher-frequency member of the two relevant TE-like bands
mode_identity.selection: Use Legume frequencies plus E/H polarization/field evidence within identified mode clusters, not a globally fixed eigenvalue index. Retain the TE subspace at Gamma.
mode_identity.shared_gauge: Vx,Vy at each k must be formed from the same mode pair and same phases before their complex sum. Cross-k phase alignment is not necessary for the plotted magnitudes.
mode_identity.gamma: Exclude undefined individual TE identity at Gamma as NaN; do not force its plotted coupling.

observable.paper: inverse coupling magnitude, arbitrary scale (original colorbar only0/infinity)
observable.computed: reciprocal of normalized coupling, shared fixed display cap; raw unnormalized complex Vx,Vy saved separately
observable.normalization: a single declared reference scale shared by all four polarization maps; no per-panel fitted matching
observable.display_cap: defined by root plot script and stored numerical metadata, not inferred from the unreported paper scale

expected_mechanism.d: extended nodal line removed away from Gamma

source_limitations: SI notes numerical errors close to Gamma caused by TE degeneracy.
No claim of full open-system QNM normalization or complete dynamic radiation validation from this overlap map.
This is tensor/phase control for the general-modulation toolbox, not a disordered-modulation literature reproduction.
